==Objectives==
Report to Merrin Rockweaver to become a great explorer!
==Description==
The Explorer's league is always looking for new members. Are you looking to see the world, and travel the seas of Azeroth in search of forgotten artifacts and buried treasures?!

Well then, you should seek out my friend Merrin Rockweaver, one of the many excavators and explorers from the league uncovering old artifacts and bones!

Head east from here and find Whelgar's Excavation site. It should be tucked against the southern mountains, so keep your eyes peeled explorer!

==Rewards==
*375 [[XP]]
*50 Reputation with [[Ironforge]]
==Progress==
Yeah, can I help you? Things are a bit of a mess here.
==Completion==
Is Menethil Harbor still in the dark about what has happened here?

I need proof to report to that fool Grovug stationed in the mountains. You'll help right?
